title: Create & manage posts on your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Google Business Profile posts older than 6 months are archived unless a date range is set.
facts.quote: Posts older than 6 months are archived unless a date range is set.

facts.fact: The featured posts feature is currently available in English only, for single-location food and drink businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
facts.quote: This feature is currently available in English for single-location food and drink businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

facts.fact: If an event post on Google Business Profile has no start or end time, the event shows as lasting 24 hours on the event dates.
facts.quote: If you don’t provide a start or end time, the event shows as lasting 24 hours on the event dates.

facts.fact: Offer posts on Google Business Profile automatically include a "View Offer" button.
facts.quote: This automatically includes a "View Offer" button on the post.

facts.fact: Google Business Profile posts that include a phone number in the description might be rejected if the number cannot be verified as connected to the business.
facts.quote: Posts that include a phone number in the post description might get rejected if they cannot be verified as being connected to the business on which they are posted.

facts.fact: After publishing, Google reviews a Business Profile post, and a post is shown publicly on Search and Maps only when its status is Live; Pending and Not approved posts do not show.
facts.quote: Live:** The post is public and shows on Search and Maps.

facts.fact: On Google Business Profile, featured posts appear in place of reviews on mobile, and customers can still access reviews by tapping the star rating or the Reviews tab.
facts.quote: When featured posts are available, customers find them in place of reviews on your Business Profile on mobile.
